en.title: Curry Barker's 'Anything But Ghosts' Sets May 2027 Release
en.summary: The writer-director behind this year's hit 'Obsession' has officially set a release date for his next project. 'Anything But Ghosts' promises a blend of scares and laughs.
en.body:
Fans of **Curry Barker** won't have to endure the usual agonizing waits for his next cinematic offering. Following the successful release of his film **Obsession** this year, Barker's follow-up, **Anything But Ghosts**, is slated to hit theaters on May 7, 2027. This news comes as a welcome announcement for those who appreciate Barker's unique blend of compelling narratives and genre exploration.

Barker, a seasoned multi-hyphenate, first gained significant attention with his breakout found-footage horror film **Milk & Serial**. For **Anything But Ghosts**, he reunites with frequent collaborator and co-writer **Cooper Tomlinson**. Both actors, who also starred in **Milk & Serial**, are set to be the co-leads in this new venture. The ensemble cast also boasts impressive names such as **Violet McGraw**, **Chris Reinacher**, **Bryce Dallas Howard**, and **Aaron Paul**. Interestingly, the script for **Anything But Ghosts** was sold and the entire film was shot *before* the major success of **Obsession**, according to industry reports. Barker himself described the film to The Hollywood Reporter as "a buddy comedy, but it’s still going to be scary and messed up." He also emphasized that it is not a direct sequel, stating, "Nobody wants the same movie twice. So people can expect it to be very differ".

## A Ghostly Buddy Comedy on the Horizon

The anticipation for **Anything But Ghosts** is palpable, especially given Barker's track record. While **Obsession** explored darker, perhaps more intense themes, the announcement of a "buddy comedy" element in his next film suggests a willingness to experiment and broaden his cinematic palette. The involvement of talents like **Aaron Paul** and **Bryce Dallas Howard** alongside emerging stars like **Violet McGraw** hints at a dynamic range of performances. The fact that the film was completed prior to **Obsession**'s breakout success adds an intriguing layer of context, suggesting a creative process unburdened by immediate expectations, allowing Barker and Tomlinson to fully realize their vision for this particular story. The blend of comedy with Barker's signature "scary and messed up" touch is precisely what draws audiences who are looking for entertainment that challenges as much as it entertains.

## What's Next for Barker and His Fans

The release date of May 7, 2027, gives fans a clear target to look forward to. With **Anything But Ghosts** already in the can, the focus now shifts to marketing and distribution, potentially offering glimpses into the film's tone and style in the coming months. The collaboration with established studios like Focus Features and Blumhouse Atomic Monster further solidifies the project's potential for wide reach. This follow-up is sure to be a major talking point for film enthusiasts eager to see how Barker continues to evolve as a filmmaker.

By Molly Templeton | Published on September 30, 2026 Photo Credit: Focus Features Comment 0 Share New Share Obsession Followup, Anything But Ghosts , Comes Out Next Year&url= target=”_blank” title=”Twitter”> Obsession Followup, Anything But Ghosts , Comes Out Next Year” target=”_blank” title=”Pinterest”> Photo Credit: Focus Features If you are tired of waiting three or more years between seasons of your favorite TV shows, or movies in your favorite series, perhaps you might consider just becoming a fan of Curry Barker. The writer-director had a hit with this year’s Obsession , and his follow-up now has a release date: Anything But Ghosts is due out May 7, 2027. Barker has been a multi-hyphenate for years, and he starred in his breakout found-footage horror film Milk & Serial . He and his frequent collaborator/co-writer Cooper Tomlinson, who both starred in Milk & Serial , are on both sides of the camera again this time around: According to Variety , the two men are “co-leads” in the film, alongside a cast that includes Violet McGraw, Chris Reinacher, Bryce Dallas Howard, and Aaron Paul. Or perhaps that should say that they were on both sides of the camera this time around. According to The Hollywood Reporter , Barker and Tomlinson sold the script for Anything But Ghosts and shot the whole film before the breakout success of Obsession . Barker told THR , “It’s a buddy comedy, but it’s still going to be scary and messed up.” But it won’t be Obsession Part II: “Nobody wants the same movie twice. So people can expect it to be very different than Obsession , but my voice will still be very strong in it,” he said. The logline for the movie says, “When a group of fame-seeking wannabe ‘ghosthunters’ find themselves in over their heads, things spiral wildly and terrifyingly out of control.” Barker has two other films in the works. In April, it was announced that he will direct a “reimagining” of The Texas Chainsaw Massacre for A24. In June, another film—an original horror concept, with no details announced—was confirmed to be in the works with Blumhouse Atomic Monster and Universal Film Group. Blumhouse Atomic Monster is also one of the production companies behind Anything But Ghosts . Obsession is, at present, the 10th highest-grossing movie of the year, and the fifth-highest-grossing horror film of all time (sitting right behind World War Z , which frankly surprises me). It is still in some theaters, and is streaming on Peacock (you can also rent it on assorted platforms).[end-mark] The post Curry Barker’s Obsession Followup, Anything But Ghosts, Comes Out Next Year appeared first on Reactor .
